## New module: `samcli/local/docker/image_build_client.py`
- **`ImageBuildClient`** — abstract base class with abstract `build_image` and `is_available` (staticmethod + abstractmethod).
- **`SDKBuildClient`** — takes a container client; `build_image` delegates to `container_client.images.build(**kwargs)` (always passing `rm=True` unless overridden) and returns the second element (build logs). `is_available` returns `(True, None)` for any engine.
- **`CLIBuildClient`** — takes `engine_type`, stored as both `engine_type` and `cli_command`. `build_image` joins a relative dockerfile to the context path, builds `docker buildx build ...` (with `--provenance=false`, `--sbom=false`, `--load`) or `finch build ...`, appends optional `--platform`/`--build-arg`/`--target`/`--rm`, runs via `subprocess.Popen`, yields each stdout line as `{"stream": line}`, and raises `docker.errors.BuildError("Build failed with exit code {code}", build_log)` on non-zero exit. `is_available` handles docker/finch/unknown per spec.
